newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC hits high on stake purchase news.
newsitem.headline: CITIC hits high on stake purchase news.

text.p: Shares of CITIC Pacific Ltd hit an all-time high in mid-morning trade on Monday after an announcement that CITIC management would buy a 15.47 percent stake in the company, brokers said.
CITIC shares topped the most actively traded list by turnover, rising HK$2.00 or 4.59 percent to HK$45.60 before falling back slightly. Volume was 2.71 million shares.

CITIC said earlier on Monday that its management team headed by chairman Larry Yung would buy a 15.47 percent stake in the company at HK$33 per share from parent China International Trust and Investment Corp Hong Kong (Holdings) Ltd.

"The move led to speculation of a possible future placement in view of its underlying need for capital for future projects," said a sales manager at a local brorkerage. "The impact was seen as positive to the share price."
Brokers said recent demand for quality red chips and blue chips made CITIC a hot buy.
